name: Calendar Opens Without a Saved Plan
features: Smart Calendar opens normally even when the authenticated user has no saved counselor plan
A clear administrative alert says لم تقم بتسجيل خطة and links directly to the plan platform
Users can still add and manage manual calendar events without a saved plan
A successful empty Supabase plan result clears stale local plan cache
Local plan cache is used only when the remote plan request fails
The global notification center also surfaces the no-plan alert across platform pages
Existing rule remains: every calendar event is automatically a reminder
